column1: # Diet dough titles (recipe-text/4): the dish words of the recipe corpus whose book recipes nearly always carry a line that names a flour, a meal, a starch, a paste, a crust, a dough, a bread, a crumb or a pasta (DietRecipeText.NamesDough), derived from the corpus, never listed by hand (proof draw 8 of ck17: 122491 Brown betty, whose one line is "enough apples to make two cupfuls"). DietRecipeText.DoughLost reads a book recipe whose title ends with one of them, and whose lines name no dough, as a dish whose base the lines lost, beside the defined DoughTerms.

# Derivation, on the local copy of the read-only staging copy of 2026-11-25 with batch w02 applied: for every live book recipe (DietRecipeText.FromBook), the last word of its title (DietFoodWords.AllWords of DietRecipeText.Title); a word is kept when it ends the titles of at least 10 book recipes and at least nine tenths of them carry a dough line.
# titles: the book recipes whose title ends with the word; with dough: those with a dough line.
